description: Create or update a Take (AddTake + SetCamera + SetRenderData + SetChecked) in one call. New takes are checked by default so they participate in batch renders; pass `checked:false` to override. Returns the take handle — ideal for building per-shot take stacks programmatically.

camera.description: Object name to link as the take's camera override.

checked.description: Checked state for batch rendering (default true on create).

clear_render_data.description: Explicitly clear the render data override.

make_active.description: Make this take the current take.

render_data.description: Render data name to link as the take's render settings override.

update_if_exists.description: If a take with this name already exists, update it instead of creating.

name: create_take
title: Create / Update Take
